recentItems.title: The Hype: BRICS youth dialogue – How AI empowers common development of the Global South
recentItems.description:
How can BRICS cooperation and AI innovation unlock new development opportunities for the Global South? We bring guests from Ethiopia and India for in-depth discussions on inclusive artificial intelligence development. The guests share their insights on China’s practical experiences in technical education and its pivotal role in advancing international technological cooperation under the BRICS mechanism. They further explore how AI innovation can empower the Global South, driving inclusive and mutually beneficial global development through talent cultivation and cross-border knowledge exchange.

recentItems.title: EU proposes social media ban for children under 13
recentItems.description:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen set out a sweeping plan to keep children safe from online dangers on Thursday, proposing to ban under-13s from social media and require online services to design safe children's accounts.

"Today, our children are engaging with some of the most sophisticated technology ever created, and it was not created with children's well-being and development in mind," von der Leyen said at a press conference.

She said the proposed EU Kids Act "will set clear boundaries in the digital world just as we do it on a daily basis in the real world."
